<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| principles | Reuse, don't re-derive. The session-record witness already exists twice: revive's conversation_live_elsewhere (crates/daemon/src/http/revive.rs ~147) and pij_harnesses::proc::claude_session_records with process_start_matches_utc_record. Extract one shared daemon helper (e.g. conversation_live_as_seat(state, harness, session) -&gt; Option&lt;LiveCopy{seat, pane, pid, proc_start}&gt;) and make revive, adopt and the stray-pane path all call it, so the three cannot drift. The code string E-RS-CONVERSATION-LIVE is defined once in Rust; the shell scripts match it as a literal, and a test pins that the literal the scripts grep equals the Rust constant (cross-runtime literal seam). The notice goes through the ordinary delivery path and is deduped by a spine event read; the read is bounded to the seat and the event kind. Scripts stay POSIX sh, exit 0, bounded, and print hook JSON only on the coded refusal. |
| composition_root | crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs (adopt and pane resolution) with the shared live-copy helper; harness/scripts/*.sh for the human-facing surfaces |
| contracts | E-RS-CONVERSATION-LIVE: one Rust constant; leads the refusal text; --json details {code, seat, pane, harness_session, pid}, spine kind seat.double-detected {seat, stray_pane, stray_pid, proc_start, harness_session}: audit and dedupe record for the notice, shared helper conversation_live_as_seat(state, harness, session) -&gt; Option&lt;LiveCopy&gt;, used by revive, adopt and the stray-pane path |
| seams | crates/daemon/src/http/identity.rs: adopt refusal (~818) and pane resolution's not-registered refusal (~1264), crates/daemon/src/http/revive.rs: conversation_live_elsewhere becomes a caller of the shared helper, harness/scripts/claude-session-start-pij.sh, claude-user-prompt-submit-pij.sh, claude-statusline-pij.sh (embedded via include_str! in crates/harnesses/src/claude_settings.rs; the daemon installs them) |

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text | check |
| --- | --- | --- |
| rk-0001 | The stray-pane check adds a filesystem scan to every unresolved pane lookup and slows refusals. | The scan runs only on the refusal path (pane unowned), never on a resolved pane; a test pins that a resolved pane does not read the sessions dir. |
| rk-0002 | A recycled pid's stale session record raises a false double. | Same pid+proc_start match as revive; a test with a mismatched start expects today's not-registered text. |
| rk-0003 | The notice loops or repeats across restarts. | Spine-event dedupe test across a simulated restart; mutation receipt deleting the dedupe. |
| rk-0004 | The hooks print malformed JSON and break the human's prompt. | Script tests parse the hook output with jq/serde and assert exit 0 on every path. |
